spatial_nodes.name: Stupa of Cankuna (Parihaspora)
spatial_nodes.description: Massive stone foundation plinth of the grand Buddhist stupa built by Lalitaditya's Turkic minister Cankuna.

spatial_nodes.name: Chaitya of Cankuna (Parihaspora)
spatial_nodes.description: Remains of the square Buddhist Chaitya hall featuring an enormous 80-ton monolithic stone floor slab.

spatial_nodes.name: Rajavihara Monastery (Parihaspora)
spatial_nodes.description: Cellular quadrangle monastery layout with central open courtyard and surrounding monk cells.

spatial_nodes.name: Parihaskeshava Vishnu Temple Plinth
spatial_nodes.description: Ruined plinth of the imperial state Vishnu temple commissioned by Emperor Lalitaditya Muktapida.

spatial_nodes.name: Sugandhesa & Avantisvamin Temples (Pattan)
spatial_nodes.description: Royal temple complex built by King Shankaravarman partly using quarried stone from Parihaspora.

spatial_nodes.name: Martand Sun Temple
spatial_nodes.description: Masterpiece Kashmiri Sun Temple built by Lalitaditya Muktapida contemporaneously with Parihaspora.

spatial_nodes.name: Pandrethan Temple (Srinagar)
spatial_nodes.description: Well-preserved Kashmiri style stone temple situated in a tank, reflecting evolved Parihaspora style masonry.

spatial_nodes.name: Sri Pratap Singh (SPS) Museum (Srinagar)
spatial_nodes.description: State museum housing stone sculptures, relief carvings, and coins recovered from Parihaspora excavations.
